recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast promotional layout featuring a central portrait of a female artist set against a white geometric pattern background, dominated by a large, diagonally-oriented logo banner and structured sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's head overlaps the lower edge of the diagonal logo banner.
The gold geometric pattern provides a textured backdrop that contrasts with the solid black of the main title.
The diagonal orientation of the top banner creates a sense of dynamic energy and upward movement.
The bottom-left text block balances the visual weight of the subject on the right.
coreInvariants: Diagonal banner angle approximately 15 degrees upward.
Geometric diamond-grid background pattern in thin gold lines.
Subject positioned in the lower right quadrant.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close portrait of the artist, positioned on the right side, occupying approximately 40% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, heavy black lettering of the main title in the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large black title, follow the diagonal down to the subject's face, and then move to the text block in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is utilized within the geometric pattern to keep the composition from feeling cluttered despite the large elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background with gold geometric linework.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the primary title and artist name.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold for the secondary text and banner borders.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) background with high contrast black elements and metallic gold accents.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters.
Geometric, blocky construction with rounded outer corners.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' is oversized and acts as a container or anchor for the diagonal banner.
Lowercase 'the' is integrated into the negative space of the larger letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, stylized display face paired with a clean, functional geometric sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, wide, and modern feel of the primary text.
Clean geometric sans-serif for the secondary information text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean white background with a subtle gold geometric diamond-grid pattern. Add a diagonal white banner with gold borders across the top third. Place a studio portrait of a blonde woman in a navy top in the lower right, ensuring her head slightly overlaps the diagonal banner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, ultra-bold black sans-serif title onto the diagonal banner. In the bottom left corner, add the artist's name in black bold sans-serif and the album details in gold bold sans-serif, left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the main title on a diagonal axis?
Is the background a gold geometric pattern on white?
Is the subject positioned on the right side?
Is the text in the bottom left corner left-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Density of the geometric background pattern

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
avoid: Overcrowding the subject's face with text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the diagonal banner does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the gold color appears metallic or consistent across all elements.
Check that the black text is perfectly legible against the white/gold background.
Confirm the geometric pattern is subtle and does not distract from the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Diagonal Banner + Geometric Pattern Background + Offset Portrait + High-Contrast Sans-Serif Typography
